name: mem_tangentConeAt_iff_exists_seq_norm_tendsto_atTop
statement: Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {s : Set E} {x y : E} : y ∈ tangentConeAt 𝕜 s x ↔ ∃ (c : ℕ → 𝕜) (d : ℕ → E), Tendsto (‖c ·‖) atTop atTop ∧ (∀ᶠ n in atTop, x + d n ∈ s) ∧ Tendsto (fun n ↦ c n • d n) atTop (𝓝 y)
